description: ITS DataHub provides the USDOT ITS DataHub catalogue for intelligent-transport datasets funded by the ITS Joint Program Office. The provider is US Department of Transportation, ITS Joint Program Office. Geographical and temporal coverage: The national portal links connected-vehicle, work-zone, trajectory and sensor datasets with separate coverage periods. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Existing records describe individual collections hosted or linked here. Those child records do not cover the full discovery portal. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
